children: RADNOR, Pa., Aug. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP (
), a nationally recognized securities litigation law firm, is investigating potential violations of the federal securities laws by EyePoint, Inc.
on behalf of investors who purchased or acquired EyePoint, Inc. securities and experienced significant financial losses.
EyePoint Reports Disappointing Phase 3 Clinical Trials

On August 17, 2026, EyePoint issued a press release "announc[ing] topline results from LUGANO, the first pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial for DURAVYU™ (vorolanib intravitreal insert) for the treatment of wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD)." Specifically, EyePoint disclosed that DURAVYU did not meet the prespecified primary endpoint -- change in best-corrected visual acuity versus on-label aflibercept -- in the full dataset of the company's Phase 3 LUGANO trial in wet age-related macular degeneration.
EyePoint's Stock Drops Over 66%
Following the news of EyePoint, Inc.'s poor clinical trial results, the company's stock price fell over 66%.
Investors who purchased EyePoint, Inc. (
) securities and experienced losses may have legal rights under the federal securities laws.
